title: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic - Everfree Forest
description:
This is a background of the Everfree Forest from the My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic TV show. It would work very well with haunted or spooky forests.

Ripped using Lunar Magic's bitmap pasting feature. Original image by Deviantart user JackiePhantom13. https://www.deviantart.com/jackiephantom13/art/MLP-FiM-FREE-BACKGROUND-2-252129820
